C0289.title: SMS Bombing Attacks Target Baidu and Nine Other Apps via Exploited Interfaces
C0289.summary: In the second quarter of 2021, an MIIT notice said the 12321 center received 20,074 complaints about malicious SMS bombing, up 7.3% quarter on quarter. Because of insufficient network security awareness and protection, the top ten websites and apps by malicious attacks from “SMS bombing platforms” included Kuaishou, Gaotu, Baidu, Pinduoduo, Zhongan Insurance, and New Oriental. The notice required relevant companies to strengthen SMS-interface security protection and remediation.
